integrity: Integral all-parameter homotopy argument via an exact simplicial decomposition, homotopy gluing, and null two-cell attachments. Independent validation has not been performed.
limitations: Classifies only K_3 square K_n for integer n at least three, without equivariant homotopy or four-row generalization; computations are finite checks; bibliographic priority cannot be guaranteed.
title: Integral homotopy of three-row rook general-position complexes
